description:
Company Overview

At Fluency, we come together under two shared passions that drive our culture: the scaling of digital ad operations, and fostering a workplace environment rooted in open communication, inclusivity, and a growth-oriented mindset. These passions not only set us apart in the industry, but also fuel our collective drive to reshape the industry and reinvent ourselves along the way. We're not just revolutionizing the digital advertising horizon, we're shaping an organization where every member feels a sense of pride and is inspired to do their best work.

Fluency is the agentic OS for advertising, with $3B in ad spend currently under management. Our platform eliminates the manual execution that traps high-performing teams in low-value work, enabling advertising organizations to thrive in the era of AI. Because Engineering now builds and ships with agents, new channels and capabilities reach the market faster than any manual go-to-market (GTM) process can handle.

As Senior Director, Product Marketing, you will tell that story at the scale it deserves and build the repeatable operating model that lets product marketing scale with the business. You will establish our processes, standards, and cross-functional rhythms—leading our transition to agentic GTM alongside Product leadership while driving both net-new acquisition and customer expansion.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Marketing Operating Model & Launch Execution

  • Own Fluency’s launch playbook across product lines, working closely with Product leadership: the processes, frameworks, and cross-functional workflows that connect product development to market readiness to revenue outcomes. This includes the full delivery pipeline and all go-to-market phases. Drive the integrated launch calendar, define what a successful launch means at Fluency’s stage, and be accountable for the commercial outcomes when we bring something new to market. 
  • Own the process discipline that closes the gap between what is built and what customer-facing teams understand to be available, stable, and sellable, with the handoffs and readiness criteria that ensure Sales, CS, and Support are fully equipped before anything reaches the market.
  • Measure and optimize launch impact through influenced pipeline, win rates, time from engineering-complete to GA, and new feature adoption.

Agentic GTM Transformation

  • Partner with Product leadership to design and run Fluency’s agentic GTM process—automating and keeping launches, enablement, documentation, and customer communications current as engineering ships faster.
  • Set the standard for production-grade AI usage across the product marketing organization (e.g., automated launch kits, enablement generation, competitive monitoring, and lifecycle content).

Packaging, Positioning & Master Platform Narrative

  • Co-own core platform and agent packaging with Product, including strategic input on naming and pricing.
  • Own the master platform narrative: translate high-level GTM direction into a platform-level story that holds up in every deal and every stage appearance, and ensure messaging coherence across product lines and outbound surfaces. Build the team and process that produce high-quality positioning consistently, stay ahead of the competitive landscape, and keep the sales team equipped to win head-to-head..
  • Shape Fluency’s GTM segmentation strategy across product lines: how we view the market, where the highest-value opportunities live, and how the portfolio should be positioned against them. Provide structured market input to Product leadership and advise the leadership team on how the portfolio meets the market.
  • Own Fluency’s master pitch deck and strategic account deck portfolio, and set the quality standard for pitch decks and collateral across the PMM team.

 

Land & Expand Motion & Revenue Enablement

  • Build the product marketing side of our land and expand motion with Product, Sales, CS, and the VP of Growth: segmentation of the installed base, expansion plays and offers, in-product and lifecycle messaging, and the path from first use to multi-product adoption.
  • Own the strategic direction of Sales and CS enablement, ensuring collateral and training directly move win rates, deal velocity, and net revenue retention.
  • Own channel integration launches as a repeatable GTM pattern, maximizing co-marketing and reimbursement-eligible programs with Amazon, Meta, TikTok, Google, and other platform partners.

External Evangelism & Customer Proof

  • Own Fluency’s external voice with analysts, press, and industry audiences.. Be a visible face in the market: speaking at industry conferences, cultivating press coverage, and showing up in the conversations our buyers are already having..
  • Build a  Customer Advisory Board (CAB) and own the advocacy programs that turn customer results into a compounding evidence system, so that customer proof makes every deal easier to close than the last..

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Build and lead the product marketing team as Fluency scales. Attract talent that raises the collective bar, mentor Senior and Staff PMMs, and be accountable for the team’s performance.
  • Provide the vision, structure, and systems the team grows within: clear standards for output quality, operating processes that keep PMM workflows in sync, and the market and ecosystem context that helps Senior PMMs take on bigger scope over time.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment as the connective tissue between Product, Business Development, and Marketing at senior level, partnering with Product Management, Creative, Brand, Sales, CS, Demand Generation, and the VP of Growth.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally within ad tech, marketing automation, or complex data operations.
  • Proven track record building and scaling high-performing PMM teams—hiring, mentoring, and maintaining a high bar for execution quality.
  • Demonstrated success driving both net-new acquisition and customer expansion motions (land-and-expand or product-led growth).
  • Hands-on experience building and running agentic or AI-assisted GTM workflows in production (beyond casual tool experimentation).
  • Deep familiarity with the digital advertising ecosystem—how agencies operate, how campaigns run across search, social, and programmatic, and how platform partners structure co-marketing.
  • Established external market presence: conference speaking, analyst relations, press coverage, or executive platform partnerships.
  • Proficiency in a modern revtech stack and data-driven performance marketing analysis.
  • A track record of building not just positioning but the operating processes that make great positioning repeatable across a team.
  • A builder’s instinct: you step into ambiguity and leave behind operating models, frameworks, and processes the team can scale with.
  • A track record of developing PMMs: setting the vision, structure, and systems that help senior team members grow

Fluency pays all employees based on U.S. nationwide averages for each role, designed to ensure pay equity. This is a full-time, remote position that requires legal authorization to work in the U.S. Starting pay range is determined by job-related skills, experience, and knowledge. The role is also eligible for a discretionary bonus, equity options, and a comprehensive benefits package including:

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families
• 401(k) plan with company match
• Four weeks of Combined Time Off (CTO), flexible schedule, and twelve holidays
• Maternity and parental leave
• Employee wellness programs and mental health support
• Remote work flexibility and home office stipends

Starting Pay Range
$141,000—$164,000 USD

At Fluency, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.

Employment decisions at Fluency are made based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications—without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
